## Review of #447 `chore(release): 0.15.0` (head 89a9f20)

Result: **not clean** (blockers below). Reviewed the diff only; nothing was built, merged, pushed or tagged.

**Checked and fine**
- Changed files: CHANGELOG.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md, RECOMMENDED.md, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, and 59 `docs/decisions/*.md` deletions. No source or test changes. `docs/decisions/README.md` is present.
- Version: `[workspace.package]` 0.14.0 -> 0.15.0. Cargo.lock changes are the 9 workspace crates' version lines only, which is what release.ps1 asserts. The AUR `pkgver` is rewritten by release.yml at tag time, so it is not part of the PR.
- RECOMMENDED.md has the `## v0.15.0 - decisions gathered at the cut` heading.
- RELEASE_NOTES.md: `0.15.0` section first, `---` separator before `# CamCraft 0.14.0`, BREAKING paragraph first (v50 -> v57, migration, the refused-by-name G54-G59 case), #424/#425 named under Known issues, contributors thanked (austin62jake, bherbruck, linuxguy123, mkinney, seelesturm, which covers every external contributor in the rows).
- CHANGELOG: 54 rows, all version 0.15.0, all 54 short shas are on origin/main, no duplicate shas, no duplicate PR numbers. Every behaviour PR merged since v0.14.0 has a row except #175 (see below).
- Closing keywords: none in the PR title, body, the three commit messages, or the added lines of the diff.

**Blockers**
1. **Docs-only PR has a row.** CHANGELOG `71f2212` (the README Tormach PathPilot row, PR #301, #267) is a docs-only change (README.md and a decision file). AGENTS.md says docs-only PRs get no row. Remove it.
2. **Main moved during the cut.** PR #446 (`test(motion)`, test file only, `Fixes #445`) merged to main at 09:04Z, after the release branch was cut from `fc9b297`. The step 4 check `git diff $tip $m` will not be empty after the release merge, so AGENTS.md step 4 (tag only on an empty diff) cannot pass as things stand. Either `git merge origin/main` into release/v0.15.0 (pushed, then re-gated and re-flagged ready) or a fresh release branch per step 2. Because this PR is already ready, the branch takes no pushes until it is turned back into a draft; it has been turned back into a draft for this.

**Non-blocking (fix in the same push if the branch is reworked)**
3. 38 of 54 rows use `(PR #M)` alone, without the `(#N, PR #M)` issue reference AGENTS.md asks for. Every row in the 0.14.0 table on main uses the full form, so this is a deviation from the table's own style (for example bd37a3b, e535cdb, 5bcdacf, 1f6e216).
4. PR #175 (`feat(post): one NC file per operation`, the #111 code merge) has no row of its own; row `9c4f0e7` cites only PR #161 (the #110 pause/home merge) for "(#110, #111)". Add `PR #175` to that row or split it.
5. RELEASE_NOTES lists the Arch/FreeBSD packaging targets (PR #309, `build(release)`) under New, but no CHANGELOG row exists for it. AGENTS.md gives release-mechanics PRs no row, so either drop it from the notes or accept the mismatch.

**Not verified:** the gate numbers in the PR body (2820 debug, clippy, release --ignored lanes, post.exe --version) were not re-run; no build was run per the review instructions.

Label: not `merge-ready`. Labelled `needs-rework`.

Review blockers fixed on release/v0.15.0 (tip 4ee3cde): merged origin/main (PR #446, test-only) and gated the delta (motion swarf_pose_continuity 5 passed; clippy camcraft-motion clean); removed the docs-only README CHANGELOG row; PR-only rows now cite their issues; PR #175 named on the one-file-per-op row. Left as a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4ee3cde15260fbc12ffc2ce167a97e471358639c -->
Delta re-review of release PR #447 at 4ee3cde (previous review on 89a9f20).

- **Main merged in:** `origin/main` is an ancestor of `origin/release/v0.15.0`. The diff against main touches only RELEASE_NOTES.md, CHANGELOG.md, RECOMMENDED.md, Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock and the removed docs/decisions/*.md (README.md kept). Nothing else differs.
- **Delta since 89a9f20:** the merge of PR #446 (`crates/motion/tests/swarf_pose_continuity.rs`, link-count limits 53/86 with rationale) and the CHANGELOG fix. Row 71f2212 is gone; it was the only row removed. No row was lost or changed hash.
- **Row format:** every new row has `(#N, PR #M)`. Spot-checked against PR bodies: #408 (#320), #405 (#318), #393 (#374), #332 (#327), #277 (#29) all match their `Fixes #N` lines. PR #175 is named in row 9c4f0e7 and its Fixes is #111, consistent with that row.
- **Closing keywords:** none in the commit messages `89a9f20..4ee3cde`.

Not built or run, per the delta scope. Verdict: clean, `merge-ready`.
